name: 44079-decodeheavy-30ba3b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), NVSwitch, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, EP=none -- one tensor-parallel group over all eight cards of one node.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM), bf16, ~30.5B total parameters = 61 GB, ~3B active per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, bounded at 1024 requests, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, safety_seconds 2700.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, prefix caching off; prompt EXACTLY 256 tokens in and EXACTLY 2048 tokens out (`ignore_eos`, temperature 1.0), so every request is one short prefill followed by 2047 decode steps of identical shape.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant on eight GPUs, generating 2048-token drafts for 128 concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine is the commit named by `setupcard.md: commit_id`; the interpreter that holds it is
# named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`. Every option absent here is left at that engine's default.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
# Matches `scenario.json`'s 128 streams: pinned, so the resident batch is one number rather than
# a client-side target the scheduler is free to exceed.
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false
